title: Replay-buffer engineering for noise-aware quantum circuit optimization
abstract: arXiv:2604.21863v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Deep reinforcement learning for quantum circuit optimization faces three bottlenecks: replay buffers that overlook temporal difference (TD) target reliability, curriculum-based architecture search requiring a full quantum-classical evaluation after every edit, and the discard of noiseless trajectories when retraining under hardware noise. We address these limitations by treating replay as a central algorithmic lever. We introduce ReaPER+, an annealed replay rule that transitions from TD-error prioritization to reliability-aware sampling as value estimates mature. ReaPER+ achieves up to 4x higher sample efficiency than fixed PER, ReaPER, and uniform replay, while matching prior on-policy solution quality with up to 32x fewer interactions At 12 qubits, fixed ReaPER reaches the lowest energy error in the fewest steps, while PER and uniform replay find more compact circuits at higher error. translated_title: 面向噪声感知量子线路优化的经验回放缓冲区工程
translated_abstract: 用于量子线路优化的深度强化学习面临三个瓶颈：忽视时序差分（TD）目标可靠性的经验回放缓冲区、需要在每次编辑后进行完整量子-经典评估的基于课程的架构搜索，以及在硬件噪声下重新训练时丢弃无噪声轨迹。我们通过将回放作为核心算法杠杆来解决这些局限。我们提出了ReaPER+，这是一种退火回放规则，随着价值估计的成熟，从TD误差优先级逐渐过渡到可靠性感知采样。与固定PER、ReaPER和均匀回放相比，ReaPER+实现了高达4倍的样本效率提升，同时以多达32倍更少的交互次数匹配了先前在策略解决方案的质量。在12量子比特任务中，固定ReaPER以最少的步骤达到最低的能量误差，而PER和均匀回放则以更高的误差找到更紧凑的线路。在扩展到20量子比特的任务上，ReaPER+……
tldr: 提出退火回放规则ReaPER+，随着价值估计成熟从TD误差优先级过渡到可靠性感知采样，使量子线路优化的深度强化学习样本效率提升高达4倍、交互次数减少多达32倍。
en_tdlr: ReaPER+, an annealed replay rule that transitions from TD-error prioritization to reliability-aware sampling as value estimates mature, achieves up to 4x higher sample efficiency and reduces interactions by up to 32x for noise-aware quantum circuit optimization with deep reinforcement learning.
